notes.title: Going Free to Play!
notes.content:
Hi Raifu Wars Fans!

We are excited to make some big announcements today; mainly that Raifu Wars will soon be available for free to everyone!

[h1]Free-to-Play[/h1]

That's right! Starting in July we plan to make the base Raifu Wars game completely free. That means anyone will be able to play online and locally, make and publish maps, and choose from any of the 8 base characters!

[h3]What if I already bought the game?[/h3]

We thank you so much for supporting us! All player profiles made before the free switch will receive special cosmetics as well as all DLC characters (including future ones) for free.

[h3]What about the mobile version?[/h3]

The mobile version will also become free. Paid customers will receive the same benefits stated above (special cosmetics and all DLC characters free). After the switch to free, new mobile customers will buy a DLC pass to get new characters.

[h3]Why are you doing this?[/h3]

This move is not motivated by profit but rather making the game available to as many people as possible. Our goal has always been to bring people across the globe together to play online, and removing the paywall allows us to invite more people to try the game. Please consider this a gift to the community for all your support. We are sincerely thankful. 🙏

[h1]Game Updates[/h1]

We are also announcing the final update roadmap of Raifu Wars. This is a bittersweet ending to our journey, but we are dedicated to going out with a bang! Here's what you can expect coming soon:

[h3]1.13.1[/h3]
[list]
[*] Modable textures: all game graphics will be loaded as PNGs
[*] Skin Colors
[*] Bug fixes and optimizations
[/list]
[h3]1.14[/h3]
[list]
[*] New character!
[*] Matchmaking
[*] Multiplayer join codes
[*] Camera rotation
[*] Support for more languages
[/list]
[h3]1.14+[/h3]
We will remain committed to fixing bugs and maintaining online services. New content such as characters, story mode, and new gamemodes may happen depending on future commercial success.

[h1]Future Yotis Studios Games[/h1]

Wrapping up Raifu Wars development frees us to work on new titles! 

We're excited to announce our next game will be forked from Raifu Wars. This means we can develop the next game faster and improvements we make along the way can be brought back into Raifu Wars! Stay tuned for more details.

[h1]Yotis Online[/h1]

Our cloud account service, [url=https://yotisonline.com/]Yotis Online[/url], meant to bridge the gap between Steam and mobile is not going anywhere! In fact, we are planning a massive revamp and overhaul of the service. Stay tuned for more!

[h1]Schneewolf Labs[/h1]

Our final announcement is introducing, Schneewolf Labs LLC, the legal entity that will publish all Yotis Studios titles going forward. This is only a formality and does not reflect any change in leadership or direction.

Schneewolf will be providing Raifu Wars with more servers to handle the anticipated increase in online games.

Thank you all again for your support! We look forward to bringing Raifu Wars to more people!

notes.title: Hello v1.7! Goodbye Early Access!
notes.content:
Hello Raifu Wars fans!

We're very excited to bring you update v1.7 and exit Early Access. We'd like to thank you all for your patience, feedback, and enthusiasm; the future is bright for Raifu Wars!

[h1]What's New[/h1]
[list]
[*] Auto and customizable UI scaling
[*] New settings menu and in-game settings menu
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/ogg/1116110/announcements/detail/3091161894500472116]New maps![/url]
[*] Profile setup for first time players
[*] Host automatically switches if they disconnect
[*] Rejoining a game will return a player to their previous slot
[*] Attack Damage options: roll for damage, 3 damage, 6 damage, and instant KO
[*] Automatic crash reporting
[*] Improved controller support
[*] Improved map display and caching
[*] Various bug fixes
[/list]

[h1]What's Next[/h1]
Leaving Early Access does NOT mean the updates and content will stop! We will continue to improve the game and add major content updates (through both free updates and paid DLC)
[list]
[*] Improved CPU players with difficulty settings
[*] Multi-controller support for local mode
[*] Control remapping
[*] Map editor overhaul
[*] Additional characters with unique abilities
[*] New gamemodes (both cooperative and competitive) 
[*] 1v1 (controlling multiple characters)
[*] Support for more than 4 players
[*] Story mode
[*] Voice acting
[*] More character customization
[*] Ability to rotate camera angle
[*] More cards, and more options for decks
[*] More objects, buildings, tiles, etc
[*] More achievements
[*] Mod support and API
[*] Multiplayer framework updates and open-sourcing
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*] Some steam features not working on macOS
[*] Menu blur renders incorrectly on some GPUs (this can be turned off in Settings under Graphics)
[*] Host disconnecting during CPU turn can hang CPU player
[*] Erratic behavior joining games before a map is selected
[*] Empty or corrupt packets sometimes cause crashes in online mode
[/list]

Stay tuned for news on the Android and iOS versions coming soon!

notes.title: Raifu Wars Map Contest
notes.content:
Calling all map creators!

We're holding a contest to include your maps into the game! There will be 3 categories with a winning prize for each:

[h3]Most Creative[/h3]

[h3]Best Gameplay[/h3]

[h3]Best Card Deck[/h3]

Our top category winners will each receive a $20 Steam gift code, and free Raifu Wars keys. Runners-up will also receive free keys and the opportunity to include their map in the game.

[h2]How to Enter[/h2] 

[list]
[*] Upload your map to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1116110/workshop/]Steam Workshop[/url]
[*] Reply to this post with a link to your map by February 20th
[*] Send us an email at yotisstudios@gmail.com or join the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.gg/P3yHsemJtg]Raifu Wars Discord[/url] (so we can send your prize if you win)
[/list]
By entering the contest you are allowing Yotis Studios to include your map in the game.

[h3]FAQ[/h3]

[b]Can I submit maps that I already uploaded to the Workshop?[/b]
Yes, we encourage you to enter any of your maps!

[b]Can I submit multiple maps?[/b]
Yep, you can submit as many maps as you want. First place prizes will however be limited to 1 per person.

[b]How do I upload to the Steam Workshop?[/b]
From the editor, save your map. You should get a prompt asking if you want to upload to the workshop, click "Yes" then wait for it to appear in the workshop.

Good luck, we luck forward to seeing your entries!

notes.title: Update 1.6 is here!
notes.content:
Hello Raifu Wars fans!

We're back with our last major update of Early Access! Thank you for sticking with us for this long; we are so excited to exit Early Access and bring the game to new platforms in the next update!

[h1]What's New[/h1]
[list]
[*] Ability to join games already in progress
[*] Editor top-down view
[*] Improved AI: can now rush, fortify, use grenades and dynamite
[*] Fix non-Latin character map names not displaying
[*] Texture mipmapping
[*] Steam Rich Presence (send invites and join games through Steam friends)
[*] New Hair Customization available at level 3
[*] New attack probability calculation: more likely to hit at closer distances
[*] New Profile screen
[*] Updated stock maps
[*] UI improvements
[*] Multiplayer bug fixes
[*] Update to latest game engine
[/list]

[h1]What's Next[/h1]
1.7 will take Raifu Wars out of Early Access with some final touches and polish. We also plan on bringing Raifu Wars to mobile on Android and iOS! Here are some things we're working on:
[list]
[*] More CPU player improvements
[*] UI scaling based on screen resolution
[*] New settings menu and options
[*] New map selection menu
[*] More editor improvements
[*] Full gamepad/controller support
[*] More maps (map contest details to be released soon)
[*] Intro and first-time profile setup for new players
[*] Updated Wiki featuring characters, tile objects, cards, and more
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*] Active card effects display improperly on Linux
[*] macOS build missing Steam features
[*] macOS build does not run on M1 hardware
[*] CPU players can hang multiplayer games in rare situation
[/list]

As always, thanks for your support! We'll likely push out minor updates before 1.7 to address any bugs that pop up.

[*] Attack Damage option: choose to roll for attack damage or do 6 damage for each hit
[*] Multi-regional online game hosting, enjoy lower latency depending on your geographic location (games are hosted in New York City or Singapore)
[*] New formula for calculating levels: level up faster!
[*] Players above level 1 can customize eye color
[*] Custom card decks that can be set in the game lobby or saved into a map through the editor
[*] Support for 64 x 64 maps (previously 49x49)
[*] Assignable starting positions for players
[*] Swappable player positions
[*] Tier Options: play for knockouts or stars only
[*] Spectator mode
[*] Most card effects now stack
[*] Card effect indicators under all players
[*] New Attack mode shows range map and target player health
[*] New Fortify option gives plus 1 defense when ammo is full
[*] Improved camera and animations
[*] UI improvements
[*] Steam Leaderboards
[*] Performance optimizations, especially for menu
[*] Various bugfixes, including crashes
[/list]

[h1]What's Next[/h1]
1.6 will be the next and last major Early Access update! Keep an eye out for contests to decide the final content of Raifu Wars!
[list]
[*] CPU player improvements and difficulty settings
[*] Ability to save games
[*] Ability to join games currently in progress
[*] UI scaling and improvements
[*] Full gamepad/controller support
[*] Improved stock maps with custom card decks
[*] Improved map compression for faster uploads and downloads
[*] Card and player balance improvements
[*] Update to latest game engine
[*] Updated Wiki featuring characters, tile objects, cards, and more
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*] Active card effects display improperly on Linux
[*] macOS build missing Steam features
[*] macOS build does not run on M1 hardware
[*] CPU players can hang multiplayer games in rare situation
[/list]

Thanks for your support! We'll patch any major issues with 1.5 but otherwise we are full steam ahead on the 1.6 update.

notes.title: We're back! Raifu Wars Early Access 1.4 is here!
notes.content:
Hello Raifu Wars fans!

We're finally back and pleased to bring you another major update! This update adds buildings, new tiles, an updated UI, new gameplay mechanics, and much more!

[h1]What's New[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added new languages: French, Italian, Polish, Portuguese
[*] Fixes and revisions for existing translations
[*] New interactive tutorial available in all languages
[*] Static movement: Every turn each player can move within 4 tiles at least once
[*] Rushing: move twice per turn by opting not to attack or reload and rolling the dice!
[*] Updated UI with improved buttons and prompts
[*] Show active card effects for each player in UI
[*] Buildings! Large objects that can span multiple tiles and completely block bullets
[*] New tiles and tile objects such as fences
[*] Path tiles decrease play movement cost by x0.5
[*] Map updates and new stock map added (Farmhouse)
[*] Singleplayer is now Local Mode: play with your friends on 1 machine with Steam Remote Play Together or hotseat
[*] 2 new music tracks
[*] Performance optimizations 
[*] Fix post-game online multiplayer crash
[*] Various bugfixes and small balance tweaks
[/list]

[h1]What's Next[/h1]
Things we're aiming to get done for update 1.5:
[list]
[*] CPU player improvements and difficulty settings
[*] Player appearance customizations
[*] Ability to save games
[*] Ability to join games currently in progress
[*] Multi-regional online game hosting
[*] Improved map previews
[*] More editor features
[*] Improve combat UI
[*] Custom card decks
[*] Card and player balance improvements
[*] Improved game options for starting positions and more
[*] 2v2 team matches
[*] Community improvements and more!
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*] Various tutorial bugs
[*] Map uploads sometimes getting stuck on macOS and Linux
[*] Active card effects display improperly on Linux
[/list]

Thanks for sticking with us all this time! Expect smaller incremental updates to roll out over the next couple weeks to fix issues and add improvements. Enjoy!

notes.title: 1.3: Mega Multiplayer Update!
notes.content:
Hello Raifu Wars fans!

We're pleased to bring you another major update! This update focuses mainly on improving the multiplayer experience through new features, improvements, and fixes.

[h1]What's New[/h1]
[h2]Multiplayer[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fix issues with map downloads and uploads when starting or joining games
[*] Fix dropped packet issue for high latency connections
[*] Add chat feature
[*] Add password protected lobbies
[*] Host can kick players from lobby
[*] Max turn length (timer): 30, 60, 120, or none (defaults to 120 seconds per turn)
[*] Improved online lobby list details
[/list]
[h2]Gameplay and Balance[/h2]
[list]
[*] Automatic tiering: just move to your base when you meet the tier conditions (base will now glow) and you will automatically be prompted for your next tier choice
[*] Passable obstacles: bushes can be landed on or passed through at +1 movement cost, marsh tiles add +3 movement cost, and reeds add +1 movement cost
[*] Stone walls completely block the chance of shots hitting
[*] Default shooting range increased to 18 tiles
[*] Probability of shot hitting drops off more aggressively at long distances
[*] Bushido card can now be played at any tier
[/list]
[h2]Editor[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fix undo and redo buttons not updating drawn tiles
[*] New tiles and objects: Marsh (with reeds), and Statue
[/list]

[h1]What's Next[/h1]
[list]
[*] New interactive and in-depth tutorial
[*] New tiles
[*] Fences and paths
[*] Buildings and other multi-tile objects
[*] Editor Improvements
[*] Character customization
[*] UI/UX improvements
[/list]

Lastly, a very sincere thank you to all of our Early Access players! Your feedback and playtesting has been crucial to improving the game through new features, balance changes, and bugfixes. Please keep sharing your feedback and bug reports with us!

notes.title: Raifu Wars 1.2: The Editor Update!
notes.content:
Hello Raifu Wars fans! 

We're pleased to finally bring you another major update! This update focuses mainly on improving the Map Editor by bringing in new tiles, obstacles, and tools. Additionally you can now share your maps on the Steam Workshop - we're excited to see what you create!

[h1]What's New[/h1]
[h2]Editor[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved UI: fewer words more icons!
[*] New tiles: brick, lilypads, patchy grass, wood
[*] New obstacles: rocks, bushes, bamboo, stone wall, cornfield, hay, scarecrow
[*] Rocks now spawn in random tiles (can be disabled in editor options)
[*] Bushes now spawn with trees in random tiles
[*] Support custom sizes and tree sparsity
[*] New tools: paintbrush, area paint, and flood fill
[*] Undo and redo support (1 tile at a time only)
[*] Ability to publish saved maps to Steam Workshop
[*] Editor bugfixes
[*] Editor performance optimizations
[/list]
[h2]Graphics[/h2]
[list]
[*] All cards have artwork
[*] Add additional sprites for trees and cacti
[*] Transparent trees setting now affects all obstacles
[/list]
[h2]Maps[/h2]
[list]
[*] Update Castles and Mississippi maps
[*] Remove Canals and Forbidden Point
[/list]
[h2]Settings[/h2]
[list]
[*] Volume control for music and effects
[/list]
[h2]CPU AI[/h2]
[list]
[*] CPU players will play some cards now
[/list]
[h2]Language[/h2]
(Thanks to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/33855818/]Nyanco Channel[/url])
[list]
[*] Simplified Chinese is now available
[*] Improvements to Korean and Japanese translations
[/list]
[h2]Misc.[/h2]
[list]
[*] Various bugfixes
[*] UI scaling improvements
[*] New player colors (yellow, brown)
[*] Steam screenshot support
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
Here are some issues we are investigating/working on:
[list]
[*] Some missing translations
[*] Erratic CPU behavior
[*] Games sometimes don't show in the lobby list until the map has been changed
[/list]

[h1]What's Next?[/h1]
Next update is planned to add new multiplayer features such as:
[list]
[*] In-game chat
[*] Password protected lobbies
[*] Ability for host to kick players
[*] Max turn length options
[*] and more!
[/list]

We always try to also include your suggestions in new updates so please keep the feedback coming!

Cheers,
Yotis Studios

notes.title: Hello World! Raifu Wars Early Access 1.1 is here!
notes.content:
Thank you everyone for your patience as we launched the game over the last couple weeks. We are pleased to deliver the first major early access update, Early Access 1.1!

[h1]What's New[/h1]
[list]
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[*] Cross-platform Steam Cloud syncing for your Raifu Wars profile and settings
[*] Support for new UI languages: German, Spanish, Russian, Japanese, Korean
[*] Game Speeds: FASTER!! reduce animation speed and make games go faster
[*] Symbols: customize your profile with one of 50+ symbols
[h2]Movement[/h2]
[*] Limit movement by number of tiles traveled
[*] Diagonals now cost √2
[h2]Combat[/h2]
[*] New algorithm for finding obstacles in bullet path (Bresenham's) that is more consistent and accurate
[*] Obstacle Bullet Path Penalties: Tree -15%, Barricade -30%
[*] Obstacles adjacent to players being attacked raise bullet path penalty 1.5x (take cover behind trees and barricades!)
[*] For attackers: adjacent obstacles do not contribute to bullet path penalty (shoot from behind cover!)
[h2]Cards[/h2]
[*] Card Art: lots of new card art has been added
[*] Rebalance deck: draw Blessings, Blitzkrieg, Retreat more to move games along faster
[h2]Misc.[/h2]
[*] Various bug fixes including fix broken Fortifications achievement
[*] UI Improvements
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*] Tutorial is only available in English
[*] Some languages are missing a few translations
[*] UI alignment issues for some languages
[*] A handful of cards still have no art
[*] Sometimes all tiles in editor draw as water tiles
[/list]

[h1]What's Next?[/h1]
The next update will target the following:
[list]
[*] Improved AI (use of cards, more strategy)
[*] Map Editor fixes and improvements
[/list]

Hopefully it'll include even more! What would you like to see in the next update?

Want to help the translation effort? Check out the JSON files in your Raifu Wars Install folder (.../steamapps/common/Raifu Wars/lang) to make your own custom language files. Then load it by setting the filename under "language" in settings.json in your local app data directory (AppData/Local/RaifuWars on Windows).

We are dedicated to making this game better! Please continue to provide your feedback and we'll do our best to incorporate it. Let's make a fun game together!

Cheers,
Yotis Studios

notes.title: Welcome to Raifu Wars Early Access!
notes.content:
Welcome to Raifu Wars!

We're very excited to finally be launching Raifu Wars on Steam Early Access. It has been a long and exciting journey the past year or so forming an indie studio and building a brand new game from the ground up to offer to the gaming community. 

We strive to build a game that's fun, well balanced, and has a great community - that's where you come in! Please join us in continuing our adventure in developing Raifu Wars by engaging with us at:

[list]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1116110/discussions/]Raifu Wars Steam Discussions[/url]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/RaifuWars]Raifu Wars Twitter (@RaifuWars)[/url]
[/list]

Like any Early Access game, we are not without bugs and unexpected behavior; we thank you in advance for you patience and feedback.

Sincerely,
Yotis Studios
